pages.text: Refined Storage 2 allows you to extend your network over long distances using wireless components with improved stability and performance. This guide explains how to set up and maintain long-distance network connections in RS2.

Required Components:$(li)Network Transmitter - Sends signals with improved stability$(li)Network Receiver - Receives signals with better cross-dimensional support$(li)Network Card - Enables wireless functionality with enhanced security$(li)Range Upgrades - Extends transmission distance with optimized power usage

Setup Process:$(li)Place Network Transmitter in source network$(li)Place Network Receiver in target network$(li)Configure both with matching channel$(li)Install Network Cards in wireless devices$(li)Add Range Upgrades to increase distance

RS2 Improvements:$(li)Enhanced signal stability across dimensions$(li)Improved power efficiency for wireless connections$(li)Better chunk loading detection$(li)Advanced security features for wireless access$(li)Optimized network synchronization
